In this video, we will explore
the jump command within Altium Designer.
With the schematic as the active document,
select Edit,
and then Jump.

Alternatively,
we can use the keyboard shortcut ‘J’.

Jumping to the origin
is as simple as typing ‘J’
then ‘O’,
or selecting Edit,
then Jump,
then origin.

The Jump command can also be used to jump
to specific coordinates within the schematic.
Selecting ‘J’,
then ‘L’
X and Y coordinates can be used.
The Jump command

also jumps to specific components
based on the reference designator.
Select ‘J’,

then ‘C’
to jump to a component.

Type in a reference designator
such as R1
to jump to that specific component.
If we jump to U1,

we can see that this is a component
with three symbol parts.
The Find Text - Jump dialog

allows jumping
to the next parts of the U1 symbol.
In this video,

we explored the Jump command
within Altium Designer.

title: Altium Training - Navigating Schematics: Jump Menu
